        raise ValueError("counts must be a numpy array")

        raise ValueError("counts must be 2-dimensional")

    if not np.issubdtype(counts.dtype, np.floating):
        raise ValueError("counts must be numeric")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(counts)):
        raise ValueError("counts contains nonfinite values")
    if np.any(counts < 0):
        raise ValueError("counts contains negative values")
    n_cells, n_features = counts.shape
    if not isinstance(n_components, int) or n_components < 1 or n_components >= n_cells:
        raise ValueError("n_components must be an integer with 1 <= n_components < n_cells")
    # Check all-zero rows
    if np.any(np.all(counts == 0, axis=1)):
        raise ValueError("counts has at least one all-zero row")
    # Step A01: IDF scaling
    df = np.count_nonzero(counts > 0, axis=0).astype(np.float64)
    idf = np.log(n_cells / (1.0 + df))
    X = counts * idf[np.newaxis, :]
    # Step A02: Row normalization to unit L2
    row_norms = np.linalg.norm(X, axis=1)
    if np.any(row_norms == 0):
        raise ValueError("Row has zero norm after IDF scaling")

    # Step A03: Compute degree matrix-free
    ones = np.ones(n_cells)
    degree = X @ (X.T @ ones) - 1.0
    if np.any(degree <= 0):
        raise ValueError("Non-positive degree encountered")
    D_inv = 1.0 / degree
    D_minus_half = np.sqrt(D_inv)
    # Step A04: Expose linear operator
    X_tilde = X * D_minus_half[:, np.newaxis]
    def matvec(v):
        return X_tilde @ (X_tilde.T @ v) - D_inv * v
    A = spla.LinearOperator((n_cells, n_cells), matvec=matvec, dtype=X.dtype)
    # Set up random seed for v0

    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = spla.eigsh(A, k=n_components, which='LA', v0=v0)
    # eigsh returns eigenvalues in ascending order; reverse to descending
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues[::-1]
    eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, ::-1]
    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors
